name: My Island Airport
detailed_description:
Roadmap

Why Early Access

I want to ensure that the time spent working on My Island Airport is focused on the right areas so I’ve decided to release the game into early access which allows me to gather player feedback and make continual improvements to the game throughout the development lifecycle. Every bit of community feedback is super valuable to help guide the direction of development and to ensure that everyone has an awesome time playing the game!


About the Game

Operate Your Very Own Airport

Take control of every aspect of your airport's operations. Purchase ground equipment from tractors to trucks to keep things running smoothly. Carefully manage your finances, balancing investments in new infrastructure with day-to-day operational costs. Track your budget, strategically acquire equipment, and watch as your small regional hub grows into a world-class airport through your expert leadership.

Aircraft Servicing

Get hands-on with aircraft maintenance like a true aviation professional. Dive into repairs by disassembling parts of aircraft and replacing damaged or missing components like weather radars and onboard computers. Find the issue, source the right parts, and bring aircraft back to life. Your technical skills will keep the skies safe.

Ground Services

You're the backbone of your airport’s operations. Refuel aircraft, provide critical ground power between flights and execute perfect plane pushbacks that would impress even seasoned air flight crews. Your ground services keep everything moving smoothly.

Cargo Delivery

Transform your airport into a vital community lifeline by managing cargo deliveries. When planes arrive loaded with packages and supplies, it's up to you to ensure every item reaches its destination. Hand deliver cargo and watch as your airport becomes an essential hub of local logistics. From critical medical supplies to everyday goods, you'll keep the community running.

And so much more!

Design Your Dream Airport

Unleash your creativity and build the airport you've always imagined. Place hangars exactly where they'll work best. Design fuel depots that make refueling a breeze. Add office buildings, control towers, and additional infrastructure that boost the stats of your airport. Add scenic elements that transform your airport from functional to spectacular. Every building and decoration tells the story of your airport.

Co-op Support

Bring your friends into the action! You and your friends can run your airport together. Divide responsibilities or work side-by-side to build the most efficient airport possible. Whether you're fixing maintenance issues, balancing the books, or designing the perfect layout, teamwork makes everything more exciting.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 6600/Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1060 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel i5 9600/Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: RTX 2060
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
